name: Agent Rules
changes: Agent Rules writes Claude Code deny rules for the private folders that you pick.
The side view shows every AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md in your vault as a folder tree.
Pick a folder to see the rule files that an agent loads there.
tip: Right-click a folder in the file explorer to make it private for agents or to add a rule file there.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Agent Rules is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trying it with your coding agents.
